writeup: Woot has the Larsen Original 4/4 cello D string in medium tension (model 6LCDLAR, maker code LC-DMED) new for $25.48. It's a solid steel core string with stainless flat-wire winding, and specialty string shops like Southwest Strings, Glasser Bows and Shar Music charge $74.10 to $87.99 for the same string. Woot showed only one left when we checked.
amazon_match_notes: ASIN from the Woot offer data, confirmed as the same Larsen Original 4/4 cello D medium string by the price checker
